name: Send Notification
description: Sends a push notification via Pushover or Prowl. Built from each service's public API docs but not verified against a live account - test with your own credentials first. Token/user key fall back to the Secrets Store (pushover.TOKEN / pushover.USER_KEY / prowl.TOKEN, set via Secrets Manager) when left blank here, so credentials don't need re-entering every run.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Pushover: app token. Prowl: API key. Leave blank to use the Secrets Store value.

parameters.name: user_key
parameters.description: Pushover only: your user key. Leave blank for Prowl, or to use the Secrets Store value.
